## Xunzi on perseverance

Xunzi (c. 310–c. 235 BCE) approaches perseverance within Confucianism. Nature (xing) tends to envy and disorder; goodness is the product of deliberate effort (wei) and teachers. Ritual and music reshape desire into civility; law supplements but cannot replace li. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets perseverance most directly—useful for searches such as “xunzi quotes on perseverance.”
